title: Expanding the RNA polymerase biocatalyst solution space for mRNA manufacture
authors: Curry E; Sedelnikova S; Rafferty J; Hulley M; Brown A
one_liner_zh: 该文聚焦RNA聚合酶筛选平台用于mRNA体外转录生产，虽涉及核酸-蛋白互作但非TF-DNA结合体系，且无AI/物理模拟建模方法，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: All mRNA products are currently manufactured in in vitro transcription (IVT) reactions that utilize single-subunit RNA polymerase (RNAP) biocatalysts. Although it is known that discrete polymerases exhibit highly variable bioproduction phenotypes, including different relative processivity rates and impurity generation profiles, only a handful of enzymes are generally available for mRNA biosynthesis. This limited RNAP toolbox restricts strategies to design and troubleshoot new mRNA manufacturing processes, which is particularly undesirable given the continuing diversification of mRNA product lines towards larger and more complex molecules. Herein, we describe development of a high-throughput RNAP screening platform, comprising complementary in silico and in vitro testing modules, that enables functional characterisation of large enzyme libraries. Utilizing this system, we identified eight novel sequence-diverse RNAPs, with associated active cognate promoters, and subsequently validated their performance as recombinant enzymes in IVT-based mRNA production processes. By increasing the number of available characterized functional RNAPs by > 130% and providing a platform to rapidly identify further potentially useful enzymes, this work significantly expands the RNAP biocatalyst solution space for mRNA manufacture, thereby enhancing capability to achieve application and molecule-specific optimisation of product yield and quality.
abstract_zh: 所有mRNA产品目前均在利用单亚基RNA聚合酶（RNAP）生物催化剂的体外转录（IVT）反应中生产。尽管已知不同聚合酶表现出高度可变的生物生产表型，包括不同的相对持续合成速率和杂质生成谱，但可用于mRNA生物合成的酶通常仅有少数几种。这种有限的RNAP工具箱限制了设计和排除新mRNA制造过程故障的策略，鉴于mRNA产品线持续向更大、更复杂分子多样化，这尤其不可取。在此，我们描述了一种高通量RNAP筛选平台的开发，该平台包含互补的计算和体外测试模块，能够对大型酶库进行功能表征。利用该系统，我们鉴定了八种新型序列多样化的RNAP，并伴有相关的活性同源启动子，随后验证了它们作为重组酶在基于IVT的mRNA生产过程中的性能。通过将可用且已表征的功能性RNAP数量增加超过130%，并提供快速识别其他潜在有用酶的平台，这项工作显著扩展了用于mRNA制造的RNAP生物催化剂解决方案空间，从而增强了实现应用和分子特异性优化产品产量与质量的能力。
